features.text: Includes adjustable cervical bars, occipital and mandibular supports, and a thoracic extension for comprehensive stability.

features.label: Customizable Fit
features.text: Adjustable chin piece, malleable occipital panel, and quick-adjust straps ensure precise and secure placement for all-day comfort.

features.label: Enhanced Comfort
features.text: Vented panels and a low-profile design reduce heat buildup, allowing for extended wear and better patient compliance.

features.label: Optimal Immobilization

features.label: Durable Construction
features.text: Made with premium materials for long-lasting support and resistance to wear and tear.
